name: Muthoot Finance Ltd.
business_summary: India's largest gold-loan NBFC (promoter-run, 73.35% promoter holding), predominantly southern India, ~5,000+ branches (model knowledge). Q2 FY27 (Sep 2026): standalone PAT Rs2,977cr (+27% y/y), consolidated Rs3,278cr (+36%), NII +34%, gold loan AUM up ~42% y/y; Stage III rose to 3.87% as short-tenure/monthly-EMI loans stress. Also microfinance (Belstar), housing (Muthoot Homefin), vehicle/personal loans, Sri Lanka subsidiary; Muthoot Money merged in Aug 2026. Stock Rs2,845, P/E 10.2, P/B 2.6, -21% in 6 months. New MD (Alexander George) appointed 2026-09-02.

revenue_mix.geography: South India ~45% / rest of India ~55% of AUM (model est.)

revenue_mix.segment: subsidiaries: microfinance, housing finance, vehicle/personal loans, Sri Lanka, other

exposures.mechanism: Gold +8%: loan per pledged gram rises at constant LTV so AUM (~Rs1.5 lakh cr, model est. from Q2 +42% y/y) grows ~+4-5% over two quarters; auction/collateral cushion widens; yield-neutral. PAT +5% x persistence ~0.6 (gold level is cyclical) + sentiment/P-E (10x) ~ +3.5. Agrees with pack elasticity +2.87 (t=+3.3). Downside asymmetry: gold is 22-26% below its January peak, and loans written near the peak are the ones nearest LTV breach.

evidence.note: gold ~22-26% below its January peak; gold ~$4,128/oz on 2026-11-05 (Moneycontrol 2026-10-23, Fortune India 2026-11-05)
Muthoot/Manappuram +up to 11% in 4 days as gold crossed Rs1.63 lakh/10g (ET 2026-08-24)

exposures.mechanism: Borrowings ~Rs1.5 lakh cr (model est.: Q2 interest Rs3,365cr x4 / ~9%); ~40% bank/floating = Rs0.6 lakh cr x 25bp = Rs150cr/yr = 1.0% of PBT (TTM financing profit Rs15,201cr). Gold loans are 3-12m tenor and reprice fast, so ~60% passes through within two quarters => net -0.4% PBT; persistence 0.5, P/E 10x multiple effect => ~-1.5.

exposures.mechanism: +50bp credit cost on gold AUM ~Rs1.55 lakh cr = Rs775cr/yr = 5.1% of PBT; persistence 0.5 => -2.6%; add sentiment on a book where Stage III is already 3.87% and rising (management cites short-tenure/monthly-EMI loans) => -3.5. Gold loans are over-collateralised so true loss given default is low; the exposure is mostly accounting/auction-delay and sentiment.

Muthoot is the single most direct gold-loan franchise.
